# ToolVerse (`https://toolverse.baby/`)

> ToolVerse is a privacy-first free online tools platform for PDFs, images, calculators, Western tax/pay estimators, writing/academic helpers, SEO utilities, developer tools, regional Pakistan finance estimates, and multi-source job discovery. Most file tools process data in the browser (Canvas / WebAssembly / Web Crypto) without uploading documents to ToolVerse servers for conversion.

## What is ToolVerse?

ToolVerse (toolverse.baby) provides 120+ live browser utilities with no signup wall for core workflows. Contact: support@toolverse.baby. About: https://toolverse.baby/legal/about · Editorial: https://toolverse.baby/legal/editorial-policy

## High-intent tools

- [Compress PDF](https://toolverse.baby/tools/pdf-compress): Shrink PDFs in-browser for email/portals (no upload).
- [Compress Image to Target Size](https://toolverse.baby/tools/compress-image-target-size): Exact KB targets (20KB / 50KB / 100KB) for portals.
- [Merge PDF Files](https://toolverse.baby/tools/pdf-merge): Private client-side PDF combine.
- [Tip Calculator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/tip-calculator) / [US Sales Tax](https://toolverse.baby/tools/us-sales-tax-calculator)
- [US Paycheck](https://toolverse.baby/tools/us-paycheck-calculator) / [UK Take-Home](https://toolverse.baby/tools/uk-take-home-pay-calculator) / [Canada Paycheque](https://toolverse.baby/tools/canada-paycheque-calculator) / [Australia PAYG](https://toolverse.baby/tools/australia-pay-calculator) — lite estimators with disclaimers
- [VAT & GST](https://toolverse.baby/tools/vat-gst-calculator): UK/AU/CA/EU presets
- [Wi‑Fi QR Code](https://toolverse.baby/tools/wifi-qr-code-generator) / [Passport Photo Maker](https://toolverse.baby/tools/passport-photo-maker)
- [HEIC to JPG](https://toolverse.baby/tools/heic-to-jpg): iPhone photos for Windows/forms.
- [YouTube Thumbnail Downloader](https://toolverse.baby/tools/youtube-thumbnail-downloader): Extract 1080p Full HD thumbnails in 1 click.
- [PayPal & Stripe Fee Calculator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/paypal-stripe-fee-calculator): Calculate precise domestic & cross-border merchant fees.
- [Freelance Hourly Rate Calculator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/freelancer-hourly-rate-calculator): Calculate billable rates accounting for tax, overhead, and profit.
- [Crypto Profit & Loss Calculator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/crypto-profit-calculator): Accurate crypto investment ROI, net profit, and fee calculation.
- [ChatGPT Prompt Enhancer](https://toolverse.baby/tools/chatgpt-prompt-generator): Engineer prompt frameworks (Persona, Task, Format) for LLMs.
- [Glassmorphism CSS Generator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/glassmorphism-css-generator): Visual frosted glass UI generator with instant CSS copy.
- [QR Code Generator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/qr-code-generator) / [Barcode Generator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/barcode-generator)
- [SEO Site Audit & Health Checker](https://toolverse.baby/tools/seo-audit-analyzer): Free Semrush Site Audit alternative.
- [Keyword Magic Explorer](https://toolverse.baby/tools/keyword-research-tool): Free keyword search volume, KD, & intent explorer.
- [Backlink & Anchor Analyzer](https://toolverse.baby/tools/backlink-checker-analyzer): Free Ahrefs backlink analyzer alternative.
- [SERP Simulator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/serp-simulator) / [Schema Generator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/schema-markup-generator)
- [Pakistan Salary Tax Estimator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/pakistan-salary-tax-estimator) / [Zakat Calculator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/zakat-calculator)
- [Global Job Finder](https://toolverse.baby/tools/global-job-finder): Discovery only — apply on original postings.

## Guides

- [Blog hub](https://toolverse.baby/blog) — pillar articles plus a how-to guide for every live tool (`/blog/how-to-{tool-slug}`, with a few tools mapped to deeper pillar posts such as PDF merge, 50KB compression, HEIC, barcodes, UTM, Pakistan tax, and remote jobs).
- Prefer linking the **tool page** for the interactive utility and the **matching guide** when the user needs steps, limits, or “when not to use.”
